name: Pachli for Mastodon
tagline: A full-featured Android client for Mastodon and similar servers.
blurb: Pachli is a full-featured client for Mastodon and similar servers.
description:
Pachli is a full-featured client for Mastodon and similar servers.

- Read, reply, filter, post, favourite, and boost posts
- Translate posts from other languages
- Your timeline is cached locally, so you can read when offline
- Draft posts now, to finish them later
- Write posts now, schedule them to send later
- Read and post from multiple accounts
- Multiple themes
- Focused on ensuring all functionality is available to people with accessibility needs
- Open source, https://github.com/pachli
